workstream: W2 — detector decode residual + per-invocation fixed overhead
machine: Mac (MPS; ffmpeg 9.0.1; python 3.12.13; torch 2.13.0; transformers 5.16.1). NOT iPhone numbers.
measurementContext: All W2 runs are same-session, back-to-back (warm OS file cache, HF cache present). P's 43.7s paddleDetect was a fully-cold first-of-day run; the like-for-like baseline here is the re-measured legacy script (26.8-30.4s). Savings are reported against the same-session baseline.

wasteCharacterization.claimUnderTest: P-latency-plan §1.2: '~17.1s decode+postproc residual (ffmpeg rawvideo full-res pipe, detect_paddle.py:59-80)'
wasteCharacterization.finding: MISATTRIBUTED. The window decode was already minimal and fast; the residual was per-detection GPU->CPU sync in the drain loop.

evidence.ffmpegWindowDecodeStandalone: ffmpeg -ss 1.386 -to 3.853 -i afn-sasebo-rally2.mp4 -f rawvideo -pix_fmt rgb24 - | wc -c -> 460,339,200 bytes = exactly 74 x 1920x1080x3 in 0.74s real. Input seeking (-ss/-to before -i) already decodes only the requested window; frame-count parity confirmed.

phaseTimedProfile_74frames.note: drain = box.tolist()/score.item()/label.item() on MPS result tensors, ~61 kept detections/frame x 3 synced transfers each = 170.7ms/frame. This is P's 'decode residual'.

defaultPath_bitEqual: drain fix: batch result boxes/scores/labels to CPU once per frame, iterate in numpy (170.7ms/frame -> ~0.3ms/frame)
model load: local HF cache first (local_files_only=True, network fallback on cache miss) — modelLoadSec 1.5-1.8s -> 0.74s and no hub HEAD round-trips

stride>1: skipped frames dropped inside ffmpeg (select filter + -fps_mode vfr) so they are never rgb24-converted nor piped (previously decoded+piped, Python skipped inference only). stride-1 ffmpeg command is byte-identical to legacy.
optIn: --decode-size WxH: ffmpeg-side scale before inference. REJECTED for default: not detection-equivalent (see equivalence.decodeSize640)
--legacy-decode: restores pre-W2 frame path + drain for A/B audits
--serve: persistent warm worker, JSONL over stdio (protocol in detect_paddle.py docstring; timings below)

equivalence.noiseFloor_legacyVsLegacy_r2: bit-equal (frames identical across two fresh legacy processes; 2833 dets + 1686 extras) — MPS inference is run-to-run deterministic on this machine, so diffs are attributable to code changes

decodeSize640_r2_REJECTED.verdict: fails the IoU>=0.99 + count-parity bar decisively (swscale-vs-PIL resampling changes model input; floor 0.08 keeps many near-threshold boxes that flip). Stays opt-in, must not default without a quality bench.
